notes: Real: since every face is a triangle and every edge joins two faces, 3F = 2E, so F is even; the eight convex deltahedra have 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16 and 20 faces (Freudenthal and van der Waerden 1947; Wikipedia 'Deltahedron'). An obscure class.
